reviews.title: v4 now adware :(
reviews.text:
I see you slipped an "update to premium" banner and a threat of ads quietly into the release without mentioning it in the notes.

Kinda sneaky, I liked the app, have used it for a few years and would've donated a few more quid if you'd asked.

reviews.title: Subscription Alert
reviews.text: Here we go again another app becoming a financial blood sucker. Please apple have apps that you do not have to sacrifice your first born.
